image_engine.label: Image engine
image_engine.description: The engine that draws the covers, for example a Home Assistant AI Task entity that supports images or an image model of the OpenAI Compatible plugin (such as OpenRouter).

style.label: Style
style.description: The look of the generated covers.

option_descriptions.music_assistant: A vibrant gradient in colors that match the playlist's mood, with a large white line-art illustration of its theme in the style of the Music Assistant app's icons and a bold white title.
option_descriptions.neon: The playlist's scene drawn in glowing neon lines on a dark background, in Music Assistant blue with one accent color, with a white neon title.
option_descriptions.spotify: One striking full-bleed image with a vivid duotone or saturated color wash and a large, bold title.
option_descriptions.apple_music: A soft, blurred, vivid mesh gradient with a small white title in the bottom-left corner.
option_descriptions.risograph: A two-color screen print illustration on off-white paper, with halftone dots and grain and a chunky printed title.
option_descriptions.gouache: A warm, painted magazine-style illustration of the playlist's scene, with a clean title at the top.

custom_prompt.label: Custom prompt
custom_prompt.description: The prompt sent to the image engine. You can use {name} or {title} (the playlist name), {context} (the seeds, era, artists and genres as sentences), {concept} (the visual concept), {artists}, {genres} and {era}.

title_overlay.label: Let Music Assistant add the playlist name
title_overlay.description: Off: the image engine designs the playlist name into the artwork. This looks the most natural, but some engines misspell it. On: the image engine makes artwork without any text and Music Assistant prints the playlist name on top, so it is always spelled correctly.

preview_playlist.label: Preview with playlist
preview_playlist.description: The playlist to make a preview cover for.

preview_style.label: Styles to preview
preview_style.description: The styles to try, shown side by side. Each style is one image generation.

preview_custom_prompt.label: Custom prompt to preview
preview_custom_prompt.description: The prompt used when Custom is one of the styles to preview. You can use the same placeholders as the custom prompt above.

preview.label: Preview cover
preview.description: Generate a cover for the chosen playlist in each style to preview, and the description the text engine would write for it. They are only shown here and do not change your settings or the playlist.

playlists.label: Playlists
playlists.description: Which playlists get a generated cover.

options.smart: Smart playlists, plus the ones I pick

extra_playlists.label: Also generate covers for
extra_playlists.description: Regular playlists that get a generated cover as well. Smart playlists are always included.

keep_existing_artwork.label: Keep existing artwork
keep_existing_artwork.description: Leave playlists alone that already have a cover of their own, such as the artwork of a streaming service or an image you added. The automatic collage never counts as a cover of its own.

generate_descriptions.label: Write descriptions
generate_descriptions.description: Give the playlists a short, Spotify-style description written by the text engine, inspired by what you play most. It is written once per playlist and put back whenever it gets replaced.

text_engine.label: Text engine
text_engine.description: The AI engine that writes the descriptions and, when enabled, the visual concept of the covers.

use_prompt_engine.label: Let the text engine write the visual concept
use_prompt_engine.description: Have the text engine turn the playlist's name, seeds, artists and genres into a scene description before the image is drawn. This costs an extra AI request per cover.

max_generations_per_hour.label: Maximum generations per hour
max_generations_per_hour.description: The number of covers, and separately of descriptions, generated per hour. The rest follow in the next hour, to keep the cost of the AI engines under control.

regenerate.label: Regenerate everything
regenerate.description: Generate new covers and descriptions for all playlists. The current ones stay in place until their replacement is ready.

manifest.description: Generates playlist covers and descriptions with AI, such as a Home Assistant AI Task entity or a model behind the OpenAI Compatible plugin, in one of several styles or with your own prompt.
